items.source: Specifically, SpringProxy, Advised, and DecoratingProxy will be appended to the set of user-specified interfaces.
items.translation: 具体来说，SpringProxy、Advised 和 DecoratingProxy 将被追加到用户指定的接口集合中。

items.source: This will always add the Advised interface unless the AdvisedSupport's "opaque" flag is on. Always adds the SpringProxy marker interface.
items.translation: 这总是会添加 `Advised` 接口，除非 `AdvisedSupport` 的"opaque"标志已开启。始终添加 `SpringProxy` 标记接口。

items.source: See AopUtils for a collection of generic AOP utility methods which do not depend on AOP framework internals.
items.translation: 参见AopUtils，其中包含一组不依赖于 AOP 框架内部实现的通用 AOP 实用方法。

items.source: This method can be useful when registering proxy hints for Spring's AOT support, as demonstrated in the following example which uses this method via a static import.
items.translation: 此方法在注册用于 Spring AOT 支持的代理提示时非常有用，如下面的示例所示，该示例通过static导入使用了此方法。

items.source: Mainly for internal use within the AOP framework.
items.translation: 主要用于 AOP 框架内部。

items.source: Check equality of the advisors behind the given AdvisedSupport objects.
items.translation: 检查给定 AdvisedSupport 对象背后的顾问的相等性。

items.source: Check equality of the proxied interfaces behind the given AdvisedSupport objects.
items.translation: 检查给定 AdvisedSupport 对象背后代理接口的相等性。

items.source: Obtain the singleton target object behind the given proxy, if any.
items.translation: 获取给定代理背后的单例目标对象（如果有）。

items.source:
Determine the ultimate target class of the given bean instance, traversing
not only a top-level proxy but any number of nested proxies as well —
as long as possible without side effects, that is, just for singleton targets.
items.translation: 确定给定 Bean 实例的终极目标类，不仅遍历顶层代理，还要遍历任意数量的嵌套代理——只要没有副作用即可，即仅针对单例目标。

items.source:
Extract the user-specified interfaces that the given proxy implements,
i.e. all non-Advised interfaces that the proxy implements.
items.translation: 提取给定代理实现的用户指定接口，即该代理实现的所有非 Advised 接口。

items.source:
Check equality of the proxies behind the given AdvisedSupport objects.
Not the same as equality of the AdvisedSupport objects:
rather, equality of interfaces, advisors and target sources.
items.translation:
检查给定 AdvisedSupport 对象背后代理的相等性。
这与 AdvisedSupport 对象的相等性不同：
而是接口、顾问和目标源的相等性。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if a supplied Class is null, is not an interface, or is a sealed interface
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的 Class 为 null，不是 接口，或者是 密封 的接口

items.source: the singleton target object managed in a SingletonTargetSource, or null in any other case (not a proxy, not an existing singleton target)
items.translation: 由 `SingletonTargetSource` 管理的单例目标对象，或在任何其他情况下（非代理、非现有单例目标）为`null`。

items.source: candidate - the (potential) proxy to check
items.translation: candidate - 要检查的（潜在）代理

items.source: candidate - the instance to check (might be an AOP proxy)
items.translation: candidate - 要检查的实例（可能是 AOP 代理）

items.source: the ultimate target class (or the plain class of the given object as fallback; never null)
items.translation: 最终目标类（或给定对象的普通类作为后备；绝不返回 `null`）

items.source: userInterfaces - the set of user-specified interfaces implemented by the component to be proxied
items.translation: userInterfaces - 由要代理的组件实现的用户指定接口集

items.source: advised - the proxy config
items.translation: advised - 代理配置

items.source: proxy - the proxy to analyze (usually a JDK dynamic proxy)
items.translation: proxy - 要分析的代理（通常是 JDK 动态代理）

items.source: all user-specified interfaces that the proxy implements, in the original order (never null or empty)
items.translation: 所有用户指定的代理实现的接口，按原始顺序（永远不会为 `null` 或空）

items.source: the complete set of interfaces that the proxy should implement
items.translation: 代理应实现的接口完整集合

items.source: the complete set of interfaces to proxy
items.translation: 代理的完整接口集

items.source:
Complete the set of interfaces that are typically required in a JDK dynamic
proxy generated by Spring AOP.
items.translation: 完成通常由 Spring AOP 生成的 JDK 动态代理所需的接口集。

items.source: Determine the complete set of interfaces to proxy for the given AOP configuration.
items.translation: 确定给定 AOP 配置需要代理的完整接口集。
